expert_topk_definition.note: Expert top sets: Feature top-10 of 30, Geo top-20 of 168.

limitations: The expert reference is a provisional AI-assisted, evidence-based annotation and does not represent formal multi-expert consensus.
Labels are not objective ground truth and do not establish causality.
Absolute attribution magnitudes are used; coefficient sign is not interpreted as crime increase/decrease.
Expert-reference attribution accuracy is not model faithfulness.
Feature multicollinearity (lags/rolling means) can inflate or dilute individual feature attributions.
Geo spatial dependence means ordinary LSOA bootstrap intervals are exploratory.

ordinary_bootstrap_exploratory.note: Exploratory only: ordinary unit bootstrap does not account for spatial dependence.

spatial_uncertainty.note: Primary geographic uncertainty: resample MSOA tokens embedded in ONS LSOA names. This is not a ward adjacency graph.
